integrity: Finite exact checks supplement a general combinatorial proof. No proof of independent priority or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: For q>=3 and n>=3 only. Scalar strong metric dimension and MMD/vertex-cover reduction are known prior contributions. A potentially prior equivalent independence-polynomial formula for a complete-graph/cycle categorical product is an uneliminated publication-priority risk; independent review has not been performed.
title: The strong-resolving-set polynomial and forcing rigidity of clique–cycle Cartesian graphs
